rendered:
The following passive-targeting systems in Table 2[1] have a particle size at or above the threshold:
- KRAS siRNA with TGF-β (PLGA/PLA-based), particle size ~180 nm[2].
- sEVs system, VEGFR2 siRNA mTOR siRNA[3], particle size ~150 nm[4] (exactly at the threshold).
- siTEAD4 (MOF@EVs), particle size ~168 nm[5].
- DDP and siVEGF (MOF), particle size ~485 nm[6].

The largest of these is the DDP and siVEGF MOF system, at ~485 nm[7]. The passive-targeting system just below the threshold, HMME siYTHDF1 at 139.83 nm[8], is excluded.
